name: mh-bookmark-organizer
description: Organize, dedupe, link-check, archive, tag and search browser bookmarks: a skill, a subagent and an MCP server over a local engine that needs nothing but Python 3.9+.

python.title: Python command
python.description: The command that starts Python 3.9 or newer: python3 on macOS and Linux, py or python on Windows.

library_dir.title: Library folder
library_dir.description: Where your bookmark library is kept (a private SQLite database with your tags, notes, snapshots and undo history). Choose a folder you back up; it is not removed when the plugin is uninstalled.

read_only.title: Read-only MCP server
read_only.description: Offer only the tools that cannot change the library. Turn this off to let Claude propose and apply changes (you still approve each one, and every apply can be undone).

no_network.title: No network tools
no_network.description: Hide the tools that contact the bookmarked sites (link checking, page archiving).
